title: collectReward is mempool-visible: searchers can sandwich a funding deposit to capture rewards intended for long-term stakers
description: collectReward(amount) is a public mempool-visible tx with a known signature. MEV bots front-run with stake(big_amount), let collectReward execute (growing rewardBalance and accStablePerShare), then back-run with claim() + withdraw, exiting with a captured slice of freshly-deposited rewards. Standard MasterChef-style MEV.
impact: MEV searchers capture a slice of freshly-deposited rewards by sandwich-staking around the collectReward tx. Long-term stakers see depressed effective APY. No direct fund theft from the protocol contract; redistributes from passive stakers to MEV bots.
attackPath: Yield-accumulator broadcasts collectReward(amount) to public mempool.
collectReward executes; rewardBalance and accStablePerShare grow.
MEV bot back-runs with claim() + withdraw, exiting with captured rewards.
likelihood: high — standard MasterChef-style MEV pattern; bots actively monitor this signature
recommendation: Route the funding tx through a private mempool (Flashbots Protect / similar). For an on-chain mitigation, see M-02: restricting collectReward to a whitelisted funder also eliminates this surface by allowing the funder to use private inclusion. Alternative: implement a stake-cooldown so a stake within N blocks of a collectReward is excluded from that batch's accrual.
classifierRationale: Standard MasterChef MEV; profile flags this as acceptable. QA.
